contract.transforms: Resolve both portal IDs from world.v1.json.world.portals. Apply portalTransform to each supplied point and direction; compare output arrays and scale with expected.
contract.simulations: Deep-clone initialState, then execute actions in order against the campaign world. A step repeats engine.step(world,state,input,dt) frames times. Do not call updateCampaign. Compare expected state after all actions.
contract.actions: look uses yaw/pitch radians; setGravity uses source cardinal up; crossPortal uses portalId; pickUp uses objectId; drop has no arguments. returns records the boolean result of these last four operations, with zero-based actionIndex.
contract.expected: Full source state is supplied, including events and untouched objects. IDs, flags, event kinds and booleans compare exactly; continuous numeric values compare with the documented tolerances. Initial held state is an explicit test setup, not proof of pickup reach.
contract.precision: Source computation is JavaScript double precision. Native render transforms may use floats; cross-language acceptance is tolerance-based, not byte-for-byte JSON equality.

simulations.description: Walk through the authored east wall into the other north.
Cross and walk backward through the reciprocal aperture.
Walk through the 1:4 arch while a weight crosses ahead of the eye.
The explicit primitive transforms player and held-object velocity and scale.
Walk on the east wall through the authored elevated aperture into an ordinary floor.
Yaw then pitch with ordinary up.
Yaw then pitch relative to east-wall up.
Rotate the body about its centre, then fall onto the east wall.
The continuous glass partition blocks forward movement.
Ray-validated pickup, collision-safe hand placement and drop.
